en: Black‑and‑white street view showing a row of two‑storey buildings with mansard roofs and dormer windows. The foreground left building has large painted signs and shuttered windows; the cobblestone street in front has several people standing and children playing, and a horse‑drawn carriage with driver stands on the right. The architecture is Central European, and the scene appears to be from the early 20th century.
